name: Emmanuel Enosh
bio: He studied Dramatic Literature and Theatre at the Faculty of Philosophy and Letters of the UNAM. He is currently in his final year of a bachelor’s degree in Cinematography at the National School of Cinematographic Arts (ENAC), where he specialises in documentary filmmaking. He is a recipient of a fellowship from the Young Creators program.

credits.title: Favours After Death
credits.overview: After a young man decides to take his own life while dressed in his best clothes, his tie comes to life, intent on breaking into his neighbour's apartment to seek help.

credits.title: Atop Babel's Tower
credits.overview: One night, Pérez, a small insomniac rat, wakes up feeling uncomfortable. To find out what's disturbing his sleep, he must descend a towering mattress tower where his commune is sleeping peacefully, unaware of his nocturnal descent.
